statBlock.name: Blackguard
statBlock.publication: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse
statBlock.description: A paladin who terrifies nearby enemies and blinds or knocks down foes with a smite.

sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make three attacks in any combination of Glaive and Shortbow.
Glaive. Melee weapon attack, +7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. A hit deals 9 (1d10 + 4) slashing damage plus 9 (2d8) necrotic damage.
Shortbow. Ranged weapon attack, +3 to hit, range 80/320 ft., one target. A hit deals 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage.
Dreadful Aspect (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest). Each enemy within 30 ft. makes a DC 13 Wisdom save. On a failure, it is frightened of the blackguard for 1 minute. If it ends its turn more than 30 ft. from the blackguard, it can repeat the save, ending the effect on a success.
sections.Spellcasting:
As an action, cast one of the following spells using Charisma (spell save DC 13).
2/day each. Command, Dispel Magic, Find Steed.
sections.Bonus actions:
Smite. Immediately after the blackguard hits a target with an attack roll, it can force that target to make a DC 13 Constitution save. On a failed save, choose Blind or Shove.
Blind. The target is blinded for 1 minute. It can repeat the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.
Shove. Push the target up to 10 ft. away from the blackguard and knock it prone.
sections.Printed source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse, p. 63.

statBlock.name: Blue Abishai
statBlock.publication: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse
statBlock.classification: Medium fiend (devil, wizard), typically lawful evil
statBlock.description: A winged devil that combines spellcasting with ranged lightning.

sections.Damage resistances: Cold. Bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks that are not silvered.
sections.Traits:
Devil's Sight. Magical darkness does not block the abishai's darkvision.
Magic Resistance. The abishai has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make three Bite or Lightning Strike attacks.
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 13 (2d10 + 2) piercing damage plus 14 (4d6) lightning damage.
Lightning Strike. Ranged spell attack, +12 to hit, range 120 ft., one target. A hit deals 36 (8d8) lightning damage.
sections.Spellcasting:
As an action, cast one of the following spells using Intelligence (spell save DC 20).
At will. Disguise Self, Mage Hand, Minor Illusion.
2/day each. Charm Person, Dispel Magic, Greater Invisibility, Wall of Force.
sections.Bonus actions: Teleport. The abishai teleports up to 30 ft. to an unoccupied space it can see and brings anything it wears or carries.
sections.Printed source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse, p. 39.

statBlock.name: Bodak
statBlock.publication: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse
statBlock.description: An undead creature whose gaze can drop a victim to 0 hit points.

sections.Languages: Abyssal, the languages it knew in life.
sections.Damage resistances: Cold, fire. Bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks.
sections.Traits:
Death Gaze. When a creature starts its turn within 30 ft. and can see the bodak's eyes, the bodak can force it to make a DC 13 Constitution save if the bodak can see it and is not incapacitated. A creature that fails by 5 or more drops to 0 hit points unless it is immune to being frightened. Any other failed save deals 16 (3d10) psychic damage. Unless surprised, the creature can avert its eyes at the start of its turn to avoid the save. This gives it disadvantage on attack rolls against the bodak until the start of its next turn. Looking at the bodak before then triggers the save immediately.
Sunlight Hypersensitivity. The bodak takes 5 radiant damage if it begins its turn in sunlight. In sunlight it has disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks.
Unusual Nature. The bodak needs no air, food, drink, or sleep.
sections.Actions:
Fist. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 4 (1d4 + 2) bludgeoning damage plus 9 (2d8) necrotic damage.
Withering Gaze. One creature the bodak can see within 60 ft. makes a DC 13 Constitution save. It takes 22 (4d10) necrotic damage on a failure or half on a success.
sections.Bonus actions: Aura of Annihilation. Turn the aura on or off. While it is active, each creature other than an undead or fiend takes 5 necrotic damage if it ends its turn within 30 ft. of the bodak.
sections.Printed source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse, p. 64.

statBlock.name: Boggle
statBlock.publication: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse
statBlock.description: A small fey that slicks the ground with oil and reaches through brief dimensional rifts.

sections.Actions:
Pummel. Melee weapon attack, +1 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 2 (1d6 - 1) bludgeoning damage.
Oil Puddle. Cover the ground in the boggle's space with an inch of nonflammable oil for 1 hour. The oil is difficult terrain for creatures other than boggles. Choose Slippery Oil or Sticky Oil when creating it.
Slippery Oil. A creature other than a boggle must make a DC 11 Dexterity save on entering the puddle or starting its turn there. On a failure, it falls prone.
Sticky Oil. A creature other than a boggle must make a DC 11 Strength save on entering the puddle or starting its turn there. On a failure, it is restrained. On its turn, the creature can spend an action to attempt a DC 11 Strength check. If it succeeds, the restraint ends and it moves to the nearest unoccupied space it chooses.
sections.Bonus actions:
Boggle Oil. The boggle secretes nonflammable oil and chooses one of the following effects. It lasts until the boggle uses this bonus action again.
Slippery Oil. The boggle has advantage on Dexterity (Acrobatics) checks to escape bonds or end grapples. It can pass through a Tiny creature's opening without squeezing.
Sticky Oil. The boggle has advantage on Strength (Athletics) checks to grapple and on ability checks to hold on to a creature, surface, or object. It can climb difficult surfaces and ceilings without an ability check.
Dimensional Rift. Create a stationary, invisible rift in an opening or frame the boggle can see within 5 ft. No side of the opening can exceed 10 ft. The rift reaches a destination within 30 ft. of the opening, either one the boggle can see or one it specifies by direction and distance. While beside the rift, the boggle can see through it and counts as being beside the destination. Anything it pushes through, including part of its body, emerges there. Only the boggle can use the rift, which closes at the end of its next turn.
sections.Printed source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse, p. 65.

statBlock.name: Boneclaw
statBlock.publication: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse
statBlock.description: An undead servant that snatches foes from 15 feet away and drags them through shadows.

sections.Languages: Common plus one language spoken by its master.
sections.Traits:
Rejuvenation. If its master lives, a destroyed boneclaw returns in 1d10 hours with all its hit points. Its new body appears within 1 mile of its master.
Unusual Nature. The boneclaw needs no air, food, drink, or sleep.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Piercing Claw attacks.
Piercing Claw. Melee weapon attack, +8 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. A hit deals 20 (3d10 + 4) piercing damage plus 11 (2d10) necrotic damage. If the target is a creature, the boneclaw can pull it up to 10 ft. closer, and the target is grappled (escape DC 14). The boneclaw has two claws. Each can attack only the creature it is grappling until that grapple ends.
Shadow Jump (Recharge 5–6). If the boneclaw is in dim light or darkness, it chooses creatures within 15 ft. Each makes a DC 14 Constitution save, taking 34 (5d12 + 2) necrotic damage on a failure. The boneclaw then teleports up to 60 ft. to an unoccupied space it can see. It can take one creature it is grappling and place it in an unoccupied space it can see within 5 ft. of its destination. Both destinations must be in dim light or darkness.
sections.Bonus actions: Shadow Stealth. In dim light or darkness, take the Hide action.
sections.Reactions: Deadly Reach. When a creature enters a space within 15 ft. of the boneclaw, make one Piercing Claw attack against it.
sections.Printed source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse, p. 66.

statBlock.name: Bulezau
statBlock.publication: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse
statBlock.description: A leaping demon with a rotting aura and a diseased tail barb.

sections.Traits:
Rotting Presence. A creature other than a demon that starts its turn within 30 ft. of the bulezau must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution save or take 3 (1d6) necrotic damage.
Standing Leap. The bulezau can long jump up to 20 ft. or high jump up to 10 ft. without needing a running start.
Sure-Footed. The bulezau has advantage on Strength and Dexterity saves against effects that would knock it prone.
sections.Actions: Barbed Tail. Melee weapon attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 8 (1d12 + 2) piercing damage plus 4 (1d8) necrotic damage. A creature hit makes a DC 13 Constitution save against disease. On a failure, it is poisoned until the disease ends, develops boils, coughs up flies, and sheds rotting skin. Every 24 hours it repeats the save. A success ends the disease. A failure reduces its hit point maximum by 4 (1d8). The creature dies if its maximum reaches 0.
sections.Printed source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse, p. 67.

statBlock.name: Cadaver Collector
statBlock.publication: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse
statBlock.description: A corpse-gathering construct that exhales paralyzing gas and calls up the spirits of its victims.

sections.Languages: Understands all languages but can't speak.
sections.Damage immunities: Necrotic, poison, psychic. Bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks that are not adamantine.
sections.Condition immunities: Charmed, exhaustion, frightened, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned.
sections.Traits:
Magic Resistance. The collector has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.
Unusual Nature. The collector needs no air, food, drink, or sleep.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Slam attacks.
Slam. Melee weapon attack, +10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 18 (3d8 + 5) bludgeoning damage plus 16 (3d10) necrotic damage.
Paralyzing Breath (Recharge 5–6). Each creature in a 30-ft. cone makes a DC 18 Constitution save. On a failure, it is paralyzed for 1 minute. It repeats the save at the end of each of its turns and ends the effect on a success.
sections.Bonus actions: Summon Specters (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest). Summon 1d4 specters without Sunlight Sensitivity in unoccupied spaces within 15 ft. of the collector. They share its initiative and act immediately after it. They fight until destroyed and vanish if the collector is destroyed.
sections.Printed source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse, p. 68.
